title: Cache upgrade crashes on startup
reason: The engineer correctly identifies the cache crash due to an invalid config directive, but does not mention the Redis upgrade/deploy that introduced the incompatibility.
root_cause: The cache (Redis) container is crashing on startup because its configuration file contains an invalid directive (`maxmemory-policy`) that the Redis 7.5 image does not accept. This causes the container to repeatedly restart and refuse connections, leading the API to return 503 errors for product searches.
truth: A deploy upgraded Redis from 7.4 to 7.5; the new version refuses to start because the existing redis.conf uses a removed configuration directive, so the cache container crashes in a restart loop and the API cannot reach it.
